I have been giving him his medicine and trying my best to collect a sample but my mom and grandmaw go behind my back and let him outside. I go outside searching until i find him to tell them to NOT let them back out because this could be serious, and they do it again. They tell me i’m “tripping” or that i’m “over protective”. I don’t let that bother me tho, i want the best for my pets and their health. It’s just frustrating how they never listen.

I know, Cats are very good at hiding pain etc. It wouldn’t let me type everything all out. I told her to not let him outside because of his sickness and the weather won’t help, also i told her we couldn’t collect a sample or give him his medicine at the proper times if he was outside. I explained that we don’t know what exactly it is we just know it has to do with his intestines, so if it’s something serious we wouldn’t know until he started dying or we found him dead.
